body.p: The Content Reuse Finder view helps you find similar content in your project or in topics referenced in the DITA Maps Manager view. It works with any type of XML document and can also be used for HTML and Markdown documents that are not well-formed.
If the view is not displayed, you can open it from Window Show View . By default, it appears in the top-right area of the editor.
The view includes the following information and options:

ul.li:
Scope - Selects the resources to search for similar content. The available options are:
Selected project resources - Searches the files and folders selected in the Project view.
Project - Searches all resources in the current project.
All opened files - Searches all files that are currently open in the editor.
Current file directory - Searches the folder that contains the current file and its subfolders.
Entire DITA map hierarchy - Searches all topics referenced by the DITA map currently open in the DITA Maps Manager view, including topics referenced through submaps.
Specified path - Searches the specified folder and its subfolders. Use the browse button to select the folder.
Element names (space- or line-separated) - Specifies the element types to include in the search.

Similarity threshold - Sets the minimum similarity score that content must meet to be included in the results. Values below 100% require an Enterprise license. You can purchase the license from the Oxygen XML purchase page. Possible values are:
100% Identical - Default setting.
95% Near-Mirror - Small differences, typos.
90% Highly similar - Minor variations, same word order.
80% Same meaning - Similar, but not identical.
50% Related - Similar, but not closely related.
Show similar content for the current file - Limits the results to the currently open file.
Ignore stop words - Excludes common stop words (e.g. and or the) from the similarity analysis.
Find similar content - Click this button to start the search.

body.p: The results are displayed in the Results view, grouped by similar findings. If you double-click a group of similar elements in the Results view, you can see a detailed list of the similar elements.

section.title: Finding Reusable Content with AI Positron
section.p: If the Oxygen AI Positron add-on is installed, it provides two separate features that can help you find and assess reusable-content candidates:

ul.li: find_possible_reusable_content tool - Lets you use natural language to ask AI Positron to find reusable-content candidates. The tool uses the same finder algorithm as this view.
Analyze reusable element candidates AI action - Lets you send candidates that were already found in the Content Reuse Finder results to AI Positron for analysis.

section.p: The find_possible_reusable_content tool is available in the Agent, DITA Agent, Planner, and Ask chat modes. For example, you can ask AI Positron to find identical paragraphs in the current DITA map, locate nearly identical list items in a specific project folder, or identify similar sections that might be consolidated into reusable content.

Based on your request, AI Positron selects the finder settings, such as which elements to analyze, the search scope, the similarity threshold, whether to ignore stop words, and the number of result groups to return. If needed, you can specify these settings in your request. For example, you can ask it to search only p and li elements, limit the search to the current file or DITA map, or use a 95% similarity threshold.
section.note: Similarity thresholds below 100% require an Enterprise license.
section.p: After AI Positron returns the candidate groups, you can ask it to compare the matches, recommend whether they should be reused, and create or update the reusable content.

To use the Analyze reusable element candidates AI action, select one or more entries in the Results view, right-click, and then select Analyze reusable element candidates. The action is available for both grouped results and the detailed list of matches within a group.
